steps: Peel the pumpkin, scoop out the seeds and cut it into small cubes.
Heat the ghee in a pan on medium heat and add the cumin. Let it sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the onion softens.
Add the pumpkin and stir for about 3 minutes, until it changes colour a little.
Add about 200 ml hot water a person and the salt. Cover and cook on medium for 10 to 15 minutes, until a spoon breaks the pumpkin easily.
Take it off the heat, let it cool a little, then blend until smooth.
Pour it back into the pan, add the pepper and heat on medium, stirring, for about a minute, until it just bubbles.
Serve with a spoon of cream and a little chopped coriander on top.
note: I used ghee, cumin and ginger for an Indian home taste instead of the oregano and thyme some sites add. Red pumpkin is sweet on its own, so there is no sugar.
